sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker, f.filled_at::text t, o.action||' '||o.side||' lim '||o.limit_price||' fill '||f.side||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity v from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-21 19:40' union all select 'chg', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,status) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-10-21 19:40' union all select 'pull', market_ticker, created_at::text, status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT23-%' and created_at > '2026-10-20' union all select 'snap', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT22-DIVI','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC','KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT24-STOC') order by market_ticker, at desc) x union all select 'open', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||status from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status in ('resting','partial','submitted') order by 1,3
